title: 分析师：Jirupu缺乏规模支撑，亏损预期上调85%
speaker: Anthony Stephens

segments.en: That's right, because it lacks the scaling resources that the tech giants, like Alibaba, Tencent Huawei have.
segments.zh: 确实如此，因为它缺乏阿里、腾讯、华为等科技巨头所拥有的规模化资源。

segments.en: At the end of the day, their AI operations in cash turns are lost making, but they're being subsidized by the cash cow businesses.
segments.zh: 归根结底，这些巨头的AI业务在现金流上亏损，但由现金牛业务补贴。

segments.en: So, for example, bike dance generates an enormous amount of advertising revenue Tencent, again, is a social media giant.
segments.zh: 例如，字节跳动产生巨额广告收入，腾讯则是社交媒体巨头。

segments.en: So, you've got these core businesses which are subsidizing the AI developments. Jirupu doesn't have that.
segments.zh: 这些核心业务在补贴AI研发，而Jirupu没有这样的支撑。

segments.en: So, it lacks scale in comparison to these big tech platforms in every respect in terms of developers, et cetera.
segments.zh: 因此，与这些大型科技平台相比，它在开发者等各个方面都缺乏规模。

segments.en: And actually, since it appeared in January, consensus has revised up. The operating losses for this year by 85%.
segments.zh: 实际上，自1月上市以来，市场共识已上调其今年运营亏损预期达85%。

segments.en: So, things are actually moving in the wrong direction. One last quick point, when we sat down here and talked about Jirupu in detail, was on the last major model launch in June.
segments.zh: 所以情况正朝着不利方向发展。最后一点，我们上次详细讨论Jirupu是在6月其重大模型发布时。
